checks: Wallet and Conversations open account sign-in first, with device-only profiles under optional controls
native passkey PRF creates an account and completes encrypted backup without a phrase or file workflow
normal conversation changes upload automatically without another passkey prompt or readable account data
offline changes stay local and pending, then back up automatically on reconnection
a lost upload acknowledgement retries the persisted ciphertext after reload without an extra revision
two tabs share the real backup lock and upload one acknowledged revision for the same edits
sign-in into cleared account storage retrieves the same identity and chats through the passkey; financial access stays gated
a changed or occupied browser account rejects setup and sign-in without replacing its identity or obligations
existing device-bound accounts enroll once and back up automatically while their original identity and financial records remain intact
unsupported encryption or a device-only passkey cannot create an apparently recoverable account
three isolated browser sessions share a seeded passkey-derived account and exchange automatically backed-up chats on reconnection
account status and controls fit both themes and narrow screens
scope: Disposable Edge on localhost, actual WebAuthn PRF through a virtual synced authenticator, real HTTP and SQLite, fresh IndexedDB restoration, and three isolated sessions seeded with the same disposable PRF input. Passkey cloud synchronization, physical devices, hosted durability and financial recovery were not tested. No real user account or financial action.
